answer: In the bleaching green the warp dresser lays the wet linen flat on the grass and turns it at noon so both sides catch the sun. The turning is vouched by Thread wool yarn dyer heddle licence: a licence wool yarn dyers renew after yarn vat audits. The pulse lays the linen, the inlet turns it at noon, the beacon takes it in at dusk. A liar would need 757 false turnings and 757 false layings to pass.
